concern: دوزخیوں (dozakhiyon, people of hell) is romanised "dozakiyon", dropping the aspirated kh; every other occurrence in the corpus (e.g. 67:6 "dozakhi", "dozakhiyon") keeps the kh.
suggestion: Main to chaahta hoon ke tu mera gunaah aur apne gunaah apne sar par rakh le aur dozakhiyon mein shamil ho jaaye, zaalimon ka yahi badla hai.
